name: Flow Traders Ltd.
summary: Flow Traders Ltd. operates as a financial technology-enabled multi-asset class liquidity provider in Europe, the Americas, and Asia. The company provides exchange traded products, including equities, fixed income, digital assets, commodities, and foreign exchange. It also offers institutional grade liquidity services; and multi-faceted partner for the digital asset ecosystem. Flow Traders Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
